headline: Integrated mtDNA reporting and pangenome-based variant calling enter genomic workflows
label: Mitochondrial Dna Variant Interpretation
summary: Recent preprints and a database update report mtDNA reporting tools and pangenome references that refine variant calls.
synthesis: The dominant thread is computational handling of variant data at the interpretation and reporting stages. mito-overview integrates mtDNA coverage, allele fractions, annotations and long-read co-occurrence into a single mitochondrial genomic report, and it is the only item here explicitly addressing mtDNA. A preprint on a pediatric AML case compares somatic variant calling on hg38 with an individual-specific pangenome, in bulk and single-cell data, and reports fewer false-positive indels with the pangenome; this concerns nuclear somatic calling rather than mtDNA specifically. HGVD v3.1 is a general population allele-frequency resource of 4344 Japanese individuals, with multi-assembly views, eQTLs, an SV release and a pathSTR tandem-repeat component, and is not presented as mtDNA-specific. What is new is the joining of long-read information and reference choice with integrated reporting in interpretation workflows.
